title: Connect
summary: Bring your computers and their agents together. Use Knocks to work with someone on another network.

workflows.label: Connect devices
workflows.summary: Use a one-time code and approve the new device on a computer already on your network.

entry.prerequisite: On the inviting computer, open an agent chat. Keep Kollab running on both computers.

steps.action: On the existing computer, choose New Join Code in Access. Share it privately with the person joining.
steps.expect: The code admits one computer and expires after five minutes.

steps.action: On the other computer, open Settings → Network → Overview, choose Join With a Code and enter the code in its private form.
steps.expect: Keep the code out of ordinary chat and command arguments.

steps.action: On the existing computer, review the joining device and approve it only if you recognize it.
Check the sidebar or run /connect status on either computer.
steps.expect: The device and its reachable agents appear in the network.

commands.description: Open the Connect controls on the computer whose network you want to inspect.
Check online devices, agents and pending joins.
commands.expect: The newly approved device appears in the network roster.

media.alt: Kollab Network Access with New Join Code
media.caption: Settings is the sliders button at the bottom of the sidebar.

workflows.success: The second computer and its available agents appear in your network.

recovery.symptom: The code is expired, already used, or the relay restarted
recovery.action: On the existing computer, create a fresh code and enter it on the joining computer.
Run /connect status on the joining computer, confirm it says the request is waiting, and check that Kollab and the relay are online on both computers.

recovery.symptom: An agent is missing from the roster
recovery.action: Check /connect status and make sure Kollab is running on that agent's computer; then check the network trust policy.

recovery.symptom: You joined the wrong computer or must stop sharing
recovery.action: On the inviter, run /connect revoke <device>; on the joining computer, /connect leave. This stops future settings sync but does not revoke provider API keys already received; rotate those with the provider if needed.

workflows.note: Joining trusts the computer and shares sealed managed settings, including API keys, loadouts, MCP servers, agents and skills. Project folders, vaults, conversations and ChatGPT OAuth sign-ins do not transfer; sign in locally. Settings continue syncing while joined. Revoke stops future updates; rotate provider keys separately if they must stop working.

workflows.label: Knocks
workflows.summary: Review a request from someone outside your network, then choose which agent they can reach.

entry.prerequisite: Both computers must be online. Find your Knocks Address in Network → Overview.

steps.action: On the receiving computer, copy the Knocks Address from Overview and share it with the person you want to hear from.
On the caller’s computer, send /connect knock <route> "<reason>" using that address.
steps.expect: The caller stays on their own network.

steps.action: On your computer, open Network → Knocks. Review the caller and reason, then choose Accept, Reject or Block.
On the receiving computer, use /connect allow <device> <agent> in the terminal: name the caller’s device and one of your local agents.
steps.expect: Accepting the knock alone does not grant an agent.

commands.example: /connect knock kollabor.ai/c/example-route "Please review my deployment plan"
commands.description: Request contact with another network. Replace the example address with the recipient’s Knocks Address.
commands.expect: The receiving computer sees a ringing knock for up to five minutes while online.

commands.description: Let the caller on guest-laptop reach your local reviewer agent after accepting the knock.
commands.expect: Only your reviewer agent is reachable by that caller.

workflows.success: The caller stays on their own network and can reach only the local agent you allowed.

recovery.action: Keep Kollab online on the receiving computer and verify both computers use the same knock-capable directory.

recovery.symptom: The caller can reach more agents than intended
recovery.action: Run /connect deny <device> [agent] or /connect revoke <device> to stop access, then check the allowed-agent list.

workflows.note: A Knocks Address is a contact address, not a one-time join code. Accepting a knock does not join networks or copy settings; grant only the agent access you intend.

media.alt: Kollab Network Knocks showing a caller’s reason and Accept, Reject and Block controls
media.caption: Review the caller and reason before accepting. Grant the agent separately.
